# doctest 2.4.12

Unmodified single header and MIT license from the official tagged release:

- https://github.com/doctest/doctest/tree/v2.4.12
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/doctest/doctest/v2.4.12/doctest/doctest.h
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/doctest/doctest/v2.4.12/LICENSE.txt

Used only by `wperf_tests`. To update, replace the header and license together
from an explicit upstream release, update this version, and validate Debug and
Release builds/tests. No configure-time network access is required.
